_doc.mode: suggest (only recommend) | approve (queue for analyst) | auto (block when autoRules met)
_doc.backend: dry-run | pf | nftables | cloudflare (tokens via CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN / CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID env)
_doc.allowlist: CIDRs never blocked (own machine addresses are always protected too)
_doc.maxBlocksPerMinute: rate limit; beyond it blocks are refused and a notification is sent
_doc.autoRules: all must hold for auto mode; severity/confidence use low<medium<high<critical; family 'Novel' is never auto-blocked
_doc.notify.slackWebhook: prefer the MAVIS_SLACK_WEBHOOK env var; never returned unmasked by the API
